why: A September 2026 preprint (arXiv:2609.18995, Ge, Wang, Xu, Zhao) claims to prove the Erdős–Rado sunflower conjecture for families of bounded VC-dimension, a restricted but genuine case of the exact stated conjecture (still open in general).
